name: Point
description: Represents a single point in a series in a chart.
remarks: The Point object is a member of the Points collection. The Points collection contains all the points in one series.
example:
With ActiveDocument.InlineShapes(1)
 If .HasChart Then
 .Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Points(3).MarkerStyle = xlDiamond
 End If
End With

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: DataLabel
properties.description: Returns the data label associated with the point. Read-only DataLabel.

properties.name: Explosion
properties.description: Returns or sets the explosion value for a pie-chart or doughnut-chart slice. Read/write Long.

properties.name: HasDataLabel
properties.description: True if the point has a data label. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: InvertIfNegative
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word inverts the pattern in the object when it corresponds to a negative number. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: MarkerBackgroundColor
properties.description: Sets the marker background color as an RGB value or returns the corresponding color index value. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MarkerBackgroundColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the marker background color as an index into the current color palette, or as one of the following XlColorIndex constants: xlColorIndexAutomatic or xlColorIndexNone. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MarkerForegroundColor
properties.description: Sets the marker foreground color as an RGB value or returns the corresponding color index value. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MarkerForegroundColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the marker foreground color as an index into the current color palette, or as one of the following XlColorIndex constants: xlColorIndexAutomatic or xlColorIndexNone. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MarkerSize
properties.description: Returns or sets the data-marker size, in points. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MarkerStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the marker style for a point or series in a line chart, scatter chart, or radar chart. Read/write XlMarkerStyle.

properties.name: PictureType
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that specifies how pictures are displayed on a column or bar picture chart. Read/write XlChartPictureType.

properties.name: ApplyPictToSides
properties.description: True if a picture is applied to the sides of the point or all points in the series. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ApplyPictToFront
properties.description: True if a picture is applied to the front of the point or all points in the series. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ApplyPictToEnd
properties.description: True if a picture is applied to the end of the point or all points in the series. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether the object has a shadow. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SecondaryPlot
properties.description: True if the point is in the secondary section of either a pie-of-pie chart or a bar-of-pie chart. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Has3DEffect
properties.description: True if a point has a three-dimensional appearance. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns the line, fill, and effect formatting for the object. Read-only ChartFormat.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: PictureUnit2
properties.description: Returns or sets the unit for each picture on the chart if the PictureType property is set to xlStackScale (if not, this property is ignored). Read/write Double.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns the height, in points, of the object. Read-only.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns the width, in points, of the object. Read-only.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns a value that represents the distance, in points, from the top edge of the object to the top edge of the chart area. Read-only.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns a value that represents the distance, in points, from the left edge of the object to the left edge of the chart area. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns the object name. Read-only.

properties.name: IsTotal
properties.description: True if the point represents a total. Read/write Boolean.

methods.name: ClearFormats
methods.description: Clears the formatting of the object.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: If the point has a picture fill, copies the picture to the Clipboard.

methods.name: Paste
methods.description: Pastes a picture from the Clipboard as the marker on the selected point.

methods.name: ApplyDataLabels
methods.signature: ApplyDataLabels([Type As XlDataLabelsType], [LegendKey As Variant], [AutoText As Variant], [HasLeaderLines As Variant], [ShowSeriesName As Variant], [ShowCategoryName As Variant], [ShowValue As Variant], [ShowPercentage As Variant], [ShowBubbleSize As Variant], [Separator As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Applies data labels to a point.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of data label to apply. Can be one of the xlDataLabelsType constants.

parameters.name: LegendKey
parameters.description: True to show the legend key next to the point. The default is False.

parameters.name: AutoText
parameters.description: True if the object automatically generates appropriate text based on content.

parameters.name: HasLeaderLines
parameters.description: For the Chart and Series objects, True if the series has leader lines.

parameters.name: ShowSeriesName
parameters.description: True to enable the series name for the data label; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: ShowCategoryName
parameters.description: True to enable the category name for the data label; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: ShowValue
parameters.description: True to enable the value for the data label; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: ShowPercentage
parameters.description: True to enable the percentage for the data label; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: ShowBubbleSize
parameters.description: True to enable the bubble size for the data label; otherwise, False.

parameters.name: Separator
parameters.description: The separator for the data label.

methods.name: PieSliceLocation
methods.signature: PieSliceLocation(loc As XlPieSliceLocation, [Index As XlPieSliceIndex]) As Double
methods.description: Returns the vertical or horizontal position of a point on a chart item, in points, from the top or left edge of the object to the top or left edge of the chart area.

parameters.name: loc
parameters.description: Specifies a horizontal or vertical coordinate.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Specifies which pie slice position coordinate to return. The default value is xlOuterCenterPoint.

methods.name: SetProperty
methods.signature: SetProperty(ID As String, Value As Variant)
